dismissalText.commentary: Michael Pepper c Santner b Topley 3 (9b 0x4 0x6 7m) SR: 33.33

dismissalComment.html: superb diving catch from Santner running back from mid-on! Pepper's misery comes to an end. In the slot, Pepper looks to loft over mid-on with a straight bat and toe-ends it. Santner turns around, runs back two-thirds of the way to the boundary, and flings himself forwards to pouch it. Top work

dismissalText.commentary: Keaton Jennings c Brown b Topley 30 (12b 3x4 2x6 18m) SR: 250

dismissalComment.html: picks out deep backward point! That just about sums up London Spirit's season. Final ball of the Powerplay, flashes a short ball away on the upper-cut, and picks out Brown on the rope. Jennings and Topley exchange a few words... doesn't look too amicable either

dismissalText.commentary: Dan Lawrence c †Pooran b Potts 2 (4b 0x4 0x6 6m) SR: 50

dismissalComment.html: feathered behind! Short ball, aimed at the ribs. Lawrence shapes to pull but is cramped for room and it flicks the glove on its way through to Pooran. Big fist-pump from Potts, who strikes early

dismissalText.commentary: Matt Critchley b Rashid 3 (7b 0x4 0x6 12m) SR: 42.85

dismissalComment.html: googly turns a mile and crashes into the stumps! Critchley had absolutely no idea how to play that. It started a long way outside the off stump, drifted in and then span even further, chopping the batter in half and pegging back the top of off. Beautiful stuff from Rashid

dismissalText.commentary: Shimron Hetmyer lbw b Rashid 5 (10b 0x4 0x6 14m) SR: 50

dismissalComment.html: smacked on the back thigh, given out! Hetmyer sends it upstairs. Height looked an issue but he was playing off the back foot. Hit him just above the knee roll, right in front of off stump, past the inside-edge as he looks to nudge through midwicket. Hawk-Eye has it hitting the top of middle and off, and Hetmyer's underwhelming Hundred season is over

dismissalText.commentary: Ravi Bopara b Potts 31 (29b 3x4 0x6 40m) SR: 106.89

dismissalComment.html: timber! Perfect yorker this time, 87mph, which sneaks under the toe of Bopara's bat and thuds into the base of middle and off stump. Potts waggles his finger at Brook as though to suggest this was a plan - admittedly a simpler one to devise than execute!

dismissalText.commentary: Andre Russell b Rashid 3 (9b 0x4 0x6 9m) SR: 33.33

dismissalComment.html: cleaned up by the googly! I said it was Dre or bust, and it looks like bust yet again for the Spirit. Big turn again on the wrong 'un. Russell clears the front leg looking to launch over wide long-on but is deceived by the googly and loses his off stump

dismissalText.commentary: Liam Dawson not out 27 (19b 2x4 1x6 25m) SR: 142.1
